newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks in London hit by Greenspan comment.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks in London hit by Greenspan comment.

text.p: Japanese stocks in London fell on Wednesday as a speech by U.S. Federal Reserve chairman Alan Greenspan urging caution on rising U.S. stock prices prompted dealers to mark down quotes in line with the Dow, traders said.

The Nikkei 50 index of leading shares traded in London was 8.55 points or 0.59 percent below Tuesday's close at 1,446.46, extending losses in Tokyo where the Nikkei 225 index ended some 79.15 points or 0.42 percent down at 18,990.92.
"We saw continued profit-taking in bank stocks, but otherwise it's been pretty quiet," one market-maker said.
"Some issues that had been doing quite well sold off fairly quickly after Greenspan's comments, but I think most of it was marking down rather than actual selling."
Pioneer was one feature which swam against the tide of Greenspan's caution, trading 92.5 yen higher from Tokyo's close at 2,242.50 yen by 1542 GMT on the back of an upgrade to "buy" by Nomura.
